lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular blobs located posterior to the fifth gill slit, following a longitudinal axis along the lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect to form a grid, with high-luminance circular nodes positioned at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges running along the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical transition from light on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 14 high-luminance blobs bounded within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a higher density observed near the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, low-diameter spots covering the rostrum and cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
